name: subtitle-craft
description: Broadcast-grade YouTube & Netflix subtitle generator (SRT & VTT). Executes a 3-stage pipeline: Vertex AI Gemini 3.8 Flash 1M context global glossary extraction, Whisper word-level acoustic ground truth (Apple Silicon MLX / faster-whisper), silence-aware chunked multimodal audio proofreading via Google Cloud Vertex AI (ADC) + GCS, physical word-boundary timestamp reprojection, rhythm sanitization, and 8-dimension streaming quality audit.
